frozen_target.question: For the exact D=d=L=1 signed outer-defect blocks beyond every fixed polylogarithmic collar, can a coefficient-sensitive joint j-v theta-Kloosterman transform, a signed selected cross-fibre argument, or another genuinely new mechanism prove the X^epsilon target or a strict owner-complete positive-power range; if not, what is the first exact inverse-transform, zero-mode, nonseparability, diagonal, endpoint, source, or restored-power obstruction?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Fix A>0, R=X^(1/4), N=floor(X), J_A=M^(3/4)(log(2X))^A, K=sqrt(NM), and J_A<V<=K. The accepted selected block is Q_U(V)=sum chi_4((k^2-j)/N)w_U((k^2-j)/N)e(-j/(2k)) over -k<=j<=k-1, V<|j|<=2V, N|(k^2-j), and positive odd quotient. Its exact pre-linearization ambient completion is -i(1+i)/(2Nq) sum_j sum_(d|N,d odd)chi_4(d)d sqrt(q_d) sum_(v mod q_d/2) Bhat_j(2dv)K(-v^2,-j;q_d), where q=4N and q_d=q/d.
quantities: Retain the literal actual profile, zero extension, support components, transition and hard endpoints, asymmetric cell -k<=j<=k-1, both defect signs, strict dyadic mask, and external B_(1,U)(1) seam.
Treat the accepted selected linearization error only on the selected graph; the exact ambient coefficient B_j retains the exact residual phase until an error is separately proved.
Retain the selector factor -i/(2N), Fourier factor 1/q, Gauss factor d sqrt(q_d), theta multiplier, every odd d|N, v mod q_d/2, zero and nonzero modes, and every outer j block.
The coefficient Bhat_j(2dv) is literal and nonseparable. A separated bounded surrogate is not admissible without an exact decomposition and total norm ledger.
Post-selection h-Cauchy is equality; the ambient rows remain distinct. Neither fact may be moved across the selection boundary.
Before claiming a gain from expanding K and summing v, compute the complete half-period v-transform and decide whether it is an inverse-Gauss self-return.
Isolate v=0 and all principal or exceptional spectral terms before estimating nonzero modes.
A square-root incidence gain closes at most V<=M^(3/2); print the complete N-M-V-d power after every outer variable is restored.
Fixed-modulus theorems, modulus averages, arbitrary coefficient large sieves, and the actual coupled coefficient are distinct interfaces.
Raw counts, Parseval norms, diagonals, theorem right sides, and optimistic separated models are upper capacities, not signed lower bounds.
The D>1 recovery fibre, L>1 rows, generic t=1, every original t>=2 layer, the Round-138 cross owner, all M2 owners, endpoint assembly, M9, and the bridge remain separate.

Produce a complete N-M-V-d and dual-frequency ledger for every Cauchy, Poisson, Kuznetsov, spectral-large-sieve, two-variable differencing, or selected cross-fibre placement.
Prove the full block target, isolate a strict owner-complete positive-power defect range, or establish the first exact coefficient, diagonal, endpoint, source-hypothesis, or power obstruction.

Source-audit every imported theta Kloosterman, half-integral Kuznetsov, bilinear fixed-modulus, spectral large-sieve, modular-root, or quadratic-frequency theorem against the literal expanded coefficient.
Independently rederive the selected cross-fibre interface from the statement-only packet and test both defect signs, all N parities, exact collisions, and endpoint ranges.
Close under exactly one label: outer_defect_signed_target, strict_outer_defect_signed_range, or outer_defect_theta_dispersion_no_go.

review_seams.requirement: The exact selected and ambient formulas retain the literal profile, mask, both signs, asymmetric cell, linearization scope, and external coefficient seam.
The q_d/2 period, inverse-Gauss constants, complete versus truncated v-transform, zero mode, exceptional terms, and every multiplier are explicit.
No theorem is applied after replacing the actual nonseparable Bhat_j(2dv) by an unlicensed product coefficient or changing a fixed modulus into an average.
Every Cauchy diagonal, exact and near collision, outer variable, gcd stratum, endpoint, and N-M-V-d power is restored before a gain is claimed.
Every imported theorem matches the literal multiplier, modulus, coefficient class, averaging variable, zero and exceptional spectrum, support, masks, endpoints, and uniformity range.
Counts, norms, diagonals, and theorem right sides are not signed lower bounds, and no broader owner or exponent is promoted without proof.
